name: What's Different?
summary: Get ready to challenge your eyes and sharpen your focus in What’s Different?, the ultimate visual puzzle game! Each level presents two seemingly identical images, but look closer. Small changes, subtle shifts, and sneaky edits are hiding in plain sight. Whether you prefer the pressure of Challenge Mode or the calm pace of Casual Mode, every round offers a satisfying mix of focus, fun, and “how did I miss that?!” moments. With clean visuals, simple controls, and that irresistible “just one more level” feeling, What’s Different? is the perfect game for anyone who loves puzzles, precision, and a good test of perception.
